study_type: New physical-visibility metric on exposed analytic fixtures, no blind object evidence
hypothesis: Center-site gating of correct ribbon area can over/under-estimate physical visible area at finite owner and occluder boundaries.

primitive.final: uint8 clip(high)*255 then PIL LANCZOS down2; unchanged

coverage.pixel_square: [x-.5,x+.5] x [y-.5,y+.5], centered at integer high raster site
coverage.rule: One straight projected finite butt-cap rectangle; collinear intermediate attachment waypoints allowed. No general joins. Canonical lexicographic endpoints; reject noncollinearity, backtracking, zero projected segments.
coverage.candidate: Sutherland-Hodgman polygon clipping to each pixel square; pixel-local shoelace area; no independent reference input.
coverage.oracle: Frozen projected endpoints; axial interval-product exact area, otherwise affine vertical y bounds from along/cross inequalities, split x integral at ALL pairwise line intersections including pixel y bounds and zero-gap crossings. Midpoint integration exact on each linear interval. No candidate clipping or projection reused.
coverage.endpoint_area_cleanup: Computed fractions <=1e-12 snap0 and >=1-1e-12 snap1 for candidate and reference before uint8; raw oracle fractions also saved. No other rounding.
coverage.final_gate: Strict full quantized uint8 and final LANCZOS equality. Any floor discrepancy is retained as NO_GO.
coverage.visibility: Unchanged owner_depth and visibility_gate at positive-area pixel CENTERS only. No within-pixel visibility claim.

physical_reference.definition: area(pixel square intersect finite butt-cap ribbon intersect finite owner rectangle minus strictly nearer occluder rectangle)
physical_reference.inputs: Only frozen prescribed 2D endpoints and analytic rectangle bounds/depths; no candidate projection, coverage, gate or depth arrays
physical_reference.oblique: Independent 1D vertical cross-section integral from along/cross half-plane inequalities and rectangle bounds; split at all affine-bound crossings, integrate positive linear thickness exactly
physical_reference.raw_and_clean: Save raw fractions, mass partitions and cleaned fractions. Snap <=1e-12 to0 and >=1-1e-12 to1 solely before matched quantization; record raw numerical error.
conservation: sum per-pixel areas equals whole-image-domain integral
oblique strip occluded area=(70-60)*2*length/abs(dx); no owner/end/y clipping for this frozen fixture
all-visible physical area equals full ribbon area
physical_reference.quantization: Same .8 ink, uint8 floor then PIL LANCZOS128->64; full arrays saved

subsets.physical_boundary: positive ribbon and 1e-10<visible_area<ribbon_area-1e-10; visibility mixed INSIDE pixel, excludes mere ribbon edge
subsets.required: visible interior all4; boundary in3 limited-visibility cases; hidden interior occluder case; unsupported interior both owner-edge cases; all-visible boundary empty
subsets.ribbon_edge: 0<ribbon<1, separately reported overlapping subset, not visibility boundary

metrics.error: signed candidate-reference; sum positive and negative separately, L1, max, mismatch count; high-area units and ink units separate; final uint8 errors /255
metrics.coverage: subset site counts and ribbon/physical/candidate area and fraction of total ribbon; no excluded difficult pixels

gates.measurement_validity: Independent reference range/partition/mass/closed-form controls, nonempty subsets, all64 inherited tests plus new reference tests, immutable candidate, historical exact replay, new exact replay, sensitivity response. Candidate mismatch does NOT invalidate measurement.
gates.physical_promotion: All4 full physical visible-area arrays and high ink match within1e-10, sums within1e-8, quantized and final exact. Any mismatch is NO_GO; do not repair or tune.
gates.engineering_invalid: Any reference/control/replay failure; preserve partials and no physical conclusion

sensitivity: reference area deletion breaks mass control
reference area addition outside ribbon breaks partition/range
regression: Replay all7 round011 cases, negative control and earlier historical chain exactly; preserve exact ties, distinct depths, round004 NO_GO,8 null controls,11 mixed cases, original validation child UNKNOWN
limits: No RaDe-GS reconstruction or P1 evidence
No temporal or visual quality inference
Only fronto-parallel finite planar owners/rectangular occluder and straight ribbons
Area ownership does not imply tested general surface visibility
